choices.label: Two brothers begin at 15px embrace inside the sunlit White Temple
Gilliam paper-cutout elders stand witness in the darkened back niches
12 hand-held hourglasses burn and extinguish in non-linear order
Time pulls the brothers to 76px apart while their open posture mirrors
The 12th tall hourglass stands between them at the sea porch
At 195px gap, the final golden grain drifts between their open arms to sea

I2_threshold.rule: Brothers gap reaches 195px as the 12th hourglass releases its ember to the sea (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: d(brothers_gap_px)/dt >= 0 after embrace; Gilliam elder cutouts remain flat paper planes.
